title: Square pyramid volume and surface area
question: A pyramid has a square base of side 6 cm and a perpendicular height of 4 cm. Find its volume and total surface area.

turn.question: A pyramid has a square base of side 6 cm and a perpendicular height of 4 cm. Find its volume and total surface area.
turn.rawResponse:
[STEP]
s is the side length of the square base, and h is the perpendicular height from the base to the apex. We want the volume V and the total surface area TSA. [WRITE:V = ?, TSA = ?,90,211]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
look at the pyramid [FOCUS:pyramid]. it has a square base and four triangular faces meeting at the top.
[/STEP]
[STEP]
the label s equals six centimeters [FOCUS:pyramid_s] is the side of the square base. the label h equals four centimeters [FOCUS:pyramid_h] is the perpendicular height, straight up from the center of the base to the apex.
[/STEP]
[STEP]
first, the volume. the rule for any pyramid is V equals one third times the base area times the height. [WRITE:V = (1/3) * A_base * h,90,277]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
the base is a square, so its area is the side squared. [WRITE:A_base = s^2,90,343]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
substitute the side length. the base area equals six squared. [WRITE:A_base = 6^2,90,409]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
six squared equals thirty six. so the base area is thirty six square centimeters. [WRITE:A_base = 36 cm^2,90,475]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
now substitute into the volume formula. V equals one third times thirty six times four. [WRITE:V = (1/3) * 36 * 4,90,541]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
one third of thirty six is twelve. twelve times four is forty eight. so the volume equals forty eight cubic centimeters. [WRITE:V = 48 cm^3,90,607]
[EMPHASIZE:last]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
next, the total surface area. that is the base area plus the lateral surface area. [WRITE:TSA = A_base + A_lateral,90,673]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
the lateral area is made of four identical triangles. each triangle has base s and height l, the slant height. so the lateral area equals four times one half s l, which is two s l. [WRITE:A_lateral = 4 * (1/2) * s * l = 2sl,90,739]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
we need the slant height l. because the apex equals directly above the center, l is the hypotenuse of a right triangle with legs h and half of s. [WRITE:l = sqrt(h^2 + (s/2)^2),90,805]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
substitute the values. l equals the square root of four squared plus three squared. [WRITE:l = sqrt(4^2 + 3^2),90,871]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
four squared is sixteen, three squared is nine. sixteen plus nine is twenty five. so l equals the square root of twenty five. [WRITE:l = sqrt(16 + 9) = sqrt(25),90,937]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
the square root of twenty five is five. so the slant height equals five centimeters. [WRITE:l = 5 cm,90,1003]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
now the lateral area. two times s times l equals two times six times five. [WRITE:A_lateral = 2 * 6 * 5,90,1069]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
two times six is twelve. twelve times five is sixty. so the lateral area equals sixty square centimeters. [WRITE:A_lateral = 60 cm^2,90,1135]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
finally, the total surface area equals the base area plus the lateral area. thirty six plus sixty. [WRITE:TSA = 36 + 60,90,1201]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
thirty six plus sixty equals ninety six. so the total surface area is ninety six square centimeters. [WRITE:TSA = 96 cm^2,90,1267]
[EMPHASIZE:last]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
check the volume: one third of the base area times the height gives forty eight, and the units are cubic centimeters, which is correct for volume. the surface area equals in square centimeters, correct for area. [WRITE:check: V = 48 cm^3, TSA = 96 cm^2,90,1333]
[/STEP]
